defect_classification.why_frozen_evidence_missed_it: P31 inherited the nine-kind cross-stage wording without separating structural canonical membership from pixel-relevant visibility/reference membership.
defect_classification.routing: Return to P20 Verification Design and P31 package materialization; preserve the valid implementation and P36 oracle work.
